name: A Clean Offer
summary: The Lattice has noticed the Beacon. Their envoy wants to talk, and to know what you think of machines.

offer.summary: Envoy Calder of the Lattice is waiting on the plaza.

warm.summary: You kept the door open. The Lattice will send more than an envoy when the Loom is found.

cold.summary: You sent the envoy away. The Lattice remembers refusals as data.
